text: At its meeting on October 9 and 10, 2024, City Council considered Item CA18.1 – Appointment of Public Members to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee and appointed the following members to the committee for a term of office starting on October 11, 2024 and ending on November 14, 2026 and until successors are appointed. - Hannah Clarke-Andrews - Alex Mihailidis These vacancies are due to the resignations of Sarah Murray effective July 19, 2023 and Ramsha Naveed effective July 8, 2024.
Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
